title: Decision-gate exact update magnitude audit
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: The rejected decision-gate smoke was optimization-underdosed: despite finite gradients, each endpoint remains within one percentage point of the exact 5% initial gate over zero and signed-basis feature probes.
material_change: Reconstruct each gate initialization exactly from its saved seed and architecture, compare every initial/final parameter tensor, and evaluate zero plus signed unit-basis synthetic probes. No policy model, game state, environment hand, or outcome is queried.
baseline: Exact seed-matched initialized ExpertGate before any optimizer step.
notes: Preregistered interpretation: if all endpoints are exact nonzero updates but every maximum absolute gate-probability change on zero/signed-basis probes is below 0.01, classify the smoke as optimizer-underdosed and admit one higher-dose calibration only. If any seed exceeds 0.01, the prior negative breadth evidence reflects a materially changed router and closes this expert pair instead.

Initial zero-hand audit attempt produced no analysis artifact: direct-script import path omitted scripts/ and a float32 unit test used exact equality. Added the standard scripts sys.path bootstrap and a 1e-6 assertion tolerance; source checkpoints were untouched.

result.summary: Exact seed-matched reconstruction verified nonzero parameter updates in all three gates, but zero and signed-basis probe output changes were microscopic: maximum 0.0001689, 0.0000743, and 0.0000193 absolute probability. All initial outputs were exactly 5%.
result.conclusion: The prior decision-gate smoke was optimization-underdosed: finite gradients and nonzero parameter movement did not produce a materially learned routing function. Its negative holdout point estimates characterize an almost fixed 5% mixture, not a trained decision-level router. This is parameter/synthetic sensitivity evidence only, with zero policy or environment queries.
result.next_step: Run exactly one preregistered higher-dose three-seed calibration using the same frozen experts, opponents, seeds, hand budgets, and gates; increase only gate optimizer dose and preserve transition/update evidence. Require material output movement plus the original breadth gates. If it fails, close this expert-pair router route.
